第21章 前往紫林坊市（第1页）
当家族长老会结束后，有关组建商队前往紫林坊市的护送任务被家族庶务堂发布出来，由于此行危险，所以，参加护送任务的贡献点也是颇高的。
刘长旭和父亲刘世昊均报名参加了护送活动。父亲刘世昊是为了得到筑基丹后，在紫林坊市筑基。而刘长旭参加护送任务则是为了历练。
本来母亲也想去，但是，考虑到还有一大家子要照顾，就留了下来！
在出发前，刘长旭将自己小院的两棵灵桃树上的72个灵桃采摘了下来。
看着刘长旭采摘灵桃，小青在一旁馋的口水都流出来了！不断向刘长旭发出要吃灵桃的意愿，跳到刘长旭的肩膀上用自己的小舌头去舔刘长旭的脸。
青狐小青此时已经长大不少，身子已经有半尺长。它有两种血脉妖术，一种是风刃术，还有一种是轮回之眼。
轮回之眼是一种非常强大的血脉妖术，也是青狐一族最为强大的手段，在它催动轮回之眼时，只要看向它的双眼，无论是是人是兽，都会被轮回之眼所迷惑，进而产生幻觉，从而不战而胜。
由于青狐小青只是一只一阶下品灵兽，无论风刃术还是轮回之眼的威力还不强，相信随着小青修为的增长，威力也会越来越强。
而且，小青非常聪明，特别懂得讨大家欢心，刘长旭的弟弟妹妹们可爱和小青玩啦！特别是刘长雪，常常将自己爱吃的东西分一半给小青，所以，这只青狐的生长速度很快。
刘长旭心中也是很喜欢小青的，小青非常懂事，刘长旭不让吃的东西，绝对不吃。
刘长旭在将灵桃采摘完毕后，就将一个灵桃给了小青，小青很快就将灵桃吃了。
刘长旭此行去紫林坊市，决定将小青带走。此时的小青已经能够对刘长旭有所帮助。
灵狐天生灵觉强大，在寻找天地灵物方面具有很大的优势，还会随着灵狐的不断进阶而进步。
灵狐斗法能力也不弱，很多高阶灵狐特别擅长迷幻类妖术，大名鼎鼎的九尾天狐在真灵中也是非常强大的存在。
小青的血脉妖术轮回之眼在灵狐一族中也是有名的存在。
刘长旭自己也用灵桃酿制了3坛桃酿。
桃酿以一阶下品碧玉灵桃为原料，以冰玉坛为酿造容器，窖藏1年方可饮用。

桃酿能助人修行，且不会产生丹毒。刘氏家族的修士很少服用丹药，就是有桃酿和灵桃的缘故。
家族也有炼丹师，如父亲刘世昊，但是家族炼丹师炼制的丹药也以回气丹和小还丹这类恢复法力和治疗伤势的丹药为主，辅助修行的丹药聚气丹，就炼制不多。
很快前往紫林坊市的日子到了，这天上午，家族前往紫林坊市的族人集合完毕！
由于此行事关重大，直接关系家族前途。所以，刘氏家族此次拿出来最强力量。
大长老刘秋生亲自带队，二长老刘秋水、四长老刘百川、父亲刘世昊均参加此次活动，还有炼气中期家族修士12人。已经将家族一半的中高端战力都带出来。
集合完毕后，庶务堂的家族修士，便将装满货物的储物袋分发给众长老。
由于，前往紫林坊市的道路崎岖不平，家族也没有运载货物的飞舟，只能将货物装入储物袋中由修士随身携带。
由于去一次紫林坊市极为不易，这一次携带的货物，除了灵桃、灵酒外，还有灵药、灵米、灵鱼等家族出产的其它灵物。
在准备就绪后，大长老刘秋生带着家族商队离开了桃山庄，开始了紫林坊市之行，族长刘百山带领留守家族的修士前来送行。
林玉莲看着远去的丈夫和儿子，心中不断祈祷丈夫、儿子平安能够归来。

Chapter 21 Heading to Zilinfang City (Page 1)
After the family elders' meeting ended, the escort mission to form a caravan to Zilinfang City was announced by the family general affairs hall. Since this trip was dangerous, the contribution points for participating in the escort mission were also quite high.
Liu Changxu and his father Liu Shihao both signed up to participate in the escort activities. His father, Liu Shihao, built the foundation in Zilinfang City in order to obtain the foundation-building pill. Liu Changxu participated in the escort mission just for experience.
Originally, my mother also wanted to go, but considering that she still had a large family to take care of, she stayed!
Before setting off, Liu Changxu picked 72 spiritual peaches from two spiritual peach trees in his courtyard.
Watching Liu Changxu picking spiritual peaches, Xiaoqing's mouth watered with greed! He kept expressing his desire to eat peaches to Liu Changxu, jumped on Liu Changxu's shoulder and licked Liu Changxu's face with his little tongue.
The green fox Xiaoqing has grown up a lot now, and his body is already half a foot long. It has two kinds of bloodline magic, one is the wind blade technique, and the other is the eye of reincarnation.
The Eye of Reincarnation is a very powerful bloodline magic, and it is also the most powerful method of the Green Fox clan. When it activates the Eye of Reincarnation, as long as you look into its eyes, no matter it is a human or an animal, you will be confused by the Eye of Reincarnation, and then you will have hallucinations, and you will win without a fight.
Since Xiaoqing, the green fox, is only a first-level low-grade spiritual beast, neither the Wind Blade Technique nor the Eye of Reincarnation is very powerful. I believe that as Xiaoqing's cultivation level increases, the power will become stronger and stronger.
Moreover, Xiao Qing is very smart and knows how to please everyone. Liu Changxu’s younger brothers and sisters are so cute playing with Xiao Qing! Especially Liu Changxue, who often gave half of his favorite food to Xiao Qing, so the green fox grew very quickly.
Liu Changxu also liked Xiao Qing very much. Xiao Qing was very sensible and would never eat anything Liu Changxu did not allow him to eat.
After Liu Changxu finished picking the spiritual peaches, he gave one to Xiaoqing, and Xiaoqing quickly ate the spiritual peach.
Liu Changxu went to Zilinfang City on this trip and decided to take Xiaoqing away. At this time, Xiaoqing was already able to help Liu Changxu.
The spirit fox is born with a powerful spiritual sense and has great advantages in finding spiritual objects in the world. It will also improve as the spirit fox continues to advance.
Spirit foxes are also good at fighting magic. Many high-level spirit foxes are particularly good at psychedelic magic. The famous nine-tailed fox is also a very powerful existence among true spirits.
Xiao Qing's bloodline magic Eye of Reincarnation is also famous among the Linghu clan.
Liu Changxu himself also brewed three jars of peach wine using Ling peaches.
The peach wine is made from first-grade low-grade jasper peach as raw material, and the ice jade altar is used as the brewing container. It can be drunk after one year of storage.
Peach wine can help people practice spiritual practice and will not produce erysipelas. The monks of the Liu family rarely take elixirs because of the peach stuffing and spiritual peach.
There are also alchemists in the family, such as his father Liu Shihao, but the elixirs refined by the family alchemists are mainly elixirs such as Qihui Dan and Xiaohuan Dan, which restore mana and treat injuries. There are not many elixirs that assist in spiritual practice, such as Qi Gathering Dan.
The day to go to Zilinfang City soon came. This morning, the clan members of the family who were going to Zilinfang City had gathered!
Because this action is of great importance, it is directly related to the future of the family. Therefore, the Liu family has shown its strongest strength this time.
The first elder Liu Qiusheng personally led the team. The second elder Liu Qiushui, the fourth elder Liu Baichuan, and his father Liu Shihao all participated in the event, as well as 12 family monks in the middle stage of Qi Refining. Half of the family's mid-to-high-end combat power has been brought out.
After the gathering was completed, the family monks from the General Affairs Hall distributed storage bags filled with goods to the elders.
Due to the rugged road to Zilinfang City, the familyThere is no flying boat to carry goods, so the goods can only be put into storage bags and carried by the monks.
Since it is extremely difficult to go to Zilinfang City, the goods carried this time include not only spiritual peaches and spiritual wine, but also other spiritual items produced by the family such as spiritual medicine, spiritual rice, and spiritual fish.
After getting ready, the great elder Liu Qiusheng left Taoshan Villa with his family caravan and began a trip to Zilinfang City. The patriarch Liu Baishan led the monks who stayed behind to see him off.
Lin Yulian looked at her husband and son who were leaving, and kept praying in her heart that her husband and son would return safely.
